4. **Try it out links**

6. **Additional info (judges only)**
   - When did you begin: October 28, 2026
   - Public URL: https://giftproof-app.vercel.app
   - Public repo: https://github.com/dmustapha/giftproof

7. **Submit** and confirm the entry is locked (capture the confirmation).
